title: Russian Tourist Visa from the UK | Application Help
description: Russian tourist visa for UK residents: tourist voucher, documents, visa length and how to apply. Our Manchester team prepares and checks it.
h1: Russian tourist visa from the UK
intro: The Russian tourist visa is for holidays and sightseeing in Russia. Every Russian tourist visa needs a tourist voucher and confirmation from a Russian tour operator or hotel. We prepare your application and check your documents.
eligibility: You are travelling for a holiday or sightseeing
You have a tourist voucher and confirmation from a Russian tour operator or hotel
You have travel medical insurance valid in Russia

sections.heading: UK government travel advice
sections.text: The UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) currently advises against all travel to Russia. If you travel against this advice, your travel insurance may not be valid, and the UK's ability to help you in Russia is very limited. Please read the [latest FCDO advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/russia) before you book.

sections.heading: What you need for a Russian tourist visa
sections.text: The key document is the visa support: a tourist voucher and tourist confirmation from a tour operator or hotel registered in Russia. Book this first, as the dates on your visa follow the dates on the confirmation. You'll also need medical insurance valid in Russia for your whole stay.

sections.heading: How long is a Russian tourist visa?
sections.text: Tourist visas are usually issued for single or double entry, for up to 30 days, to match the dates on your tourist confirmation. For longer visits to friends or family, see the [Russian family visa](/russia-family-visa/).

sections.heading: Russian tourist visa help in Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help with Russian tourist visa applications for clients across the UK. Most applications can be handled by post and email, so you don't need to visit us in person.

faqs.q: Can I get a Russian tourist visa without a tour?
faqs.a: You still need a tourist voucher and confirmation, but many hotels and tour operators issue these for independent travellers.

faqs.q: Can British citizens get a Russian e-Visa?
faqs.a: The UK isn't on Russia's e-Visa list, so British citizens need a regular visa.

faqs.q: Does the UK government advise against travel to Russia?
faqs.a: Yes. The FCDO currently advises against all travel to Russia. Check the latest advice on GOV.UK before making plans.
